title: 1,000 People Get Life Changing Surgery
description: People have been waiting years for a surgery that only takes 10 minutes. So we brought doctors together to help 1,000 patients, and we could not believe what happened next.

title: Rescuing Child Slaves in Africa
description: Ghana Make A Difference is a remarkable organization that provides shelter, education and medical care to children who have been enslaved, endangered or abandoned.

title: We Built Lifesaving Clinics Around The World
description: In many parts of the world, basic medical care just isn’t accessible. People live hours from the nearest doctor, or don’t have access at all. That’s what this project set out to change.
